correctness.rationale: The frozen 44-facet labelled GenusSix triangulation has 12 vertices, all 66 edges, Euler characteristic -10 and 44 triangular faces, each edge in exactly two faces. Independent GF(2) facial-boundary elimination gives rank 43 and dim H1=66-11-43=12. Exhausting all C(12,3)=220 triples leaves 176 empty triangles, and EVERY reduced boundary is nonzero. Exactly 110 homology classes have carrier multiplicities 1:56,2:48,4:6. Independently enumerating all 12*22 link-compatible permutations retains exactly 12 facet automorphisms and yields class orbits (12,1)x4,(4,1)x2,(12,2)x3,(6,2)x2,(6,4)x1. Standard mod-two separating criterion on an orientable closed surface identifies every nonzero triangular cycle as nonseparating, and no simple simplicial loop is shorter than three edges. This is exact exhaustive finite verification for this fixed labelled triangulation, not a generalization to the other 58 genus-six surfaces.

evidence: Classification of 59 12-vertex genus-six surfaces and known order-12 automorphism of surface #58 provide a broader object census, not the homological distribution of its missing triangles. Other published triangle systole spectra concern different triangulations, dimensions or genera.
broader_coverage.reasoning: A theorem enumerating all surfaces would dominate only if it ALSO computed the per-cycle homology assignments; the known classification and symmetry data do not imply the claimed 176/110/56,48,6 distribution.

value.rationale: The complete minimum-length mod-two homology carrier spectrum of a natural maximally symmetric neighborly genus-six triangulation, including the rare fourfold classes and symmetry orbit, is a nontrivial topologically meaningful invariant. It distinguishes the arrangement of 176 shortest curves among 110 H1 classes, going beyond the known f-vector or automorphism order. Restricted to the natural length-three layer rather than an arbitrary numerical slice.
